title: 第519章 母女
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

下一秒，云峰忽然伸出了大手，然后。

熊本太郎和身边的十多个小弟直接爆成了一团血雾，惨死当场。

一时间，所有的吃瓜群众都惊呆了，不明白是怎么回事。

不过他们很快就明白了，这件事肯定是眼前这个黄皮肤黑头发的夏国人干的，他是超级强者。

不过很快他们就开心得很，毕竟山口组在这个神帝城欺男霸女，坏事没少做，今天遭遇了这个悲惨的下场也是报应。

再看现场，山口组的人没死光，还剩下一个身材矮小，脸上长着一根长长的黑毛的家伙。

“魔鬼，你是魔鬼？”

他看着云峰惊呼道，对方一伸手就能轰死这么多人，不是魔鬼是什么。

“呵呵，你们山口组很牛逼吗？在大街上欺负人，现在给你机会叫人，把山口组的高手全部叫来。”

云峰淡淡的道，丢给了眼前这个家伙一个手机，让对方叫人。

“不用了，我们来了。”

哪知道就在此刻，忽然一声冷傲的声音传来了，然后一群穿着和服、手持武士刀的日国男子走了过来。

诸多人定睛一看，发现他们大概有50多人的样子，每个人身体气息强大，都是非常厉害的存在。

为首的是一个家伙，则手持一把木剑，脸上也是有一道刀疤，看起来很凶恶。

“啊，他们是山口组第77分堂的人，这个刀疤脸是77堂主，他叫鬼川，他据说是鬼圣的弟弟。”

“是啊，这大夏国的小子完蛋了，惹到了鬼川。”

诸多周围看热闹的人议论纷纷起来，都认为云峰完蛋了，竟然惹到了山口组的人，惹到了鬼川。

“鬼川大人？就是他，一郎组长被他杀了，被这个大夏国人杀了。”

看到救援来后，先前矮个子、脸上长黑毛的家伙连忙哭泣着对鬼川讲述了事情经过，讲述了他们如何被云峰击杀。

“八嘎！废物！”

鬼川听完大怒，直接一巴掌打在了这个脸上长黑毛的家伙的脸上，将其打翻在地。

然后鬼川的目光则看着云峰，冷冷的用日语道：“你的，什么的干活？为什么和我大日帝国作对？和我们山口组作对。”

此刻的云峰的嘴里叼着一根华子，面对鬼川的质问，他则笑了起来。

他一巴掌直接隔空将鬼川身边的一个鬼子轰成了血雾，鲜血撒了鬼川一身。

一时间，鬼川和诸多人都惊呆了，看着身上的血，不明白是怎么回事。

“我的，杀日国人的干活。”

在他们惊恐的眼神中，云峰淡淡的道。

“是的，我小师弟有个毛病，一天不杀日国人，全身都不舒服。”

一边的二师姐马蓉也笑了起来，调侃道。

“八嘎！”

“杀了他。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The next second, Yunfeng suddenly stretched out his big hand, and then.

Taro Kumamoto and more than a dozen of his younger brothers around him exploded into a ball of blood mist and died tragically on the spot.

For a moment, all the melon-eaters were stunned and didn't understand what was going on.

But they soon understood that this matter must have been done by the yellow-skinned and black-haired Xia man in front of them. He was a super strong man.

But they soon became very happy. After all, the Yamaguchi-gumi bullied men and dominated women in the God Emperor City and did many bad things. The tragic ending they encountered today was also retribution.

Looking at the scene again, everyone in the Yamaguchi group was not dead. There was still a short guy with a long black hair on his face.

"Devil, are you the devil?"

He looked at Yunfeng and exclaimed, the other person could kill so many people with just a stretch of his hand, he was nothing but a devil.

"Haha, are you Yamaguchi-gumi awesome? You bully people on the street. Now I give you a chance to call people. Call all the masters of Yamaguchi-gumi."

Yunfeng said calmly, throwing a mobile phone to the guy in front of him and asking him to call someone.

"No, we're here."

Unexpectedly, at this moment, a cold and arrogant voice suddenly came, and then a group of Japanese men wearing kimonos and holding samurai swords came over.

Many people took a closer look and found that there were probably more than 50 of them. Each of them had a strong body and aura, and they were all very powerful beings.

The leader was a guy who was holding a wooden sword and had a scar on his face. He looked very vicious.

"Ah, they are from the 77th branch of the Yamaguchi-gumi. This scarred face is the leader of the 77th branch. His name is Onikawa. It is said that he is the younger brother of Onishi."

"Yes, this boy from Daxia Kingdom is finished. He has offended Guichuan."

Many people watching the excitement started talking, thinking that Yunfeng was doomed, and they had offended the Yamaguchi-gumi people and Onikawa.

"Lord Onikawa? It was him. Team leader Ichiro was killed by him. He was killed by this Daxia countryman."

After seeing the rescue coming, the previously short guy with black hair on his face quickly cried and told Onikawa what happened and how they were killed by Yunfeng.

"Baga! Waste!"

After hearing this, Onikawa was furious and slapped the guy with black hair on the face, knocking him to the ground.

Then Onikawa looked at Yunfeng and said coldly in Japanese: "What kind of work are you doing? Why are you going against the Japanese Empire? Are you going against our Yamaguchi group?"

At this moment, Yunfeng had a flower stick in his mouth, and he laughed when faced with Guichuan's question.

He slapped a Japanese man next to Guichuan directly from the air and turned him into a blood mist. The blood spread all over Guichuan.

For a moment, Guichuan and many others were stunned. Looking at the blood on their bodies, they didn't understand what was going on.

"My job is to kill Japanese people."

In their frightened eyes, Yunfeng said calmly.

"Yes, my junior brother has a problem. If he doesn't kill Japanese people for a day, he will feel uncomfortable all over his body."

Second senior sister Ma Rong on the side also laughed and joked.

"Baga!"

"Kill him."
